label: Prior
term: prior (simply, in time, in substance, or in being)
resolution: When the aporia of Metaphysics XII.6, 1071b22-24, and the Night cosmogony (1071b26-28) say that potency is prior, the case reads 'prior' as simple priority (`PriorSimply`), the sense of the premise STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY. Only on that reading are STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT and STMT-NIGHT-UNPRECEDED-POTENCY-ACTUALIZED rivals of the premise. Aristotle's first answer ('nothing that is will be', 1071b24-26) and his later remark that chaos or night did not exist for an infinite time (1072a7-8) also touch priority in time, and he grants that to think potency prior is 'in a way right' (1072a3-4). On the temporal reading the position is compatible with the premise: Aquinas grants that potency precedes act in time within one changing thing (ST I q.3 a.1 co.), so it is not formalized as a rival. Every statement of the elimination GENERATION-FROM-NIGHT-REFUTED uses the one predicate `PriorSimply`, so no step passes from one sense to the other. Metaphysics IX.8, 1050b6-7, and In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 1 say that incorruptible beings are prior to corruptible ones in substance and perfection. The case reads that as PriorInSubstance (DEF-PRIORITY-IN-SUBSTANCE), not as PriorSimply: ActPriorFromIncorruptibleFacts reaches simple priority from it only through the explicit unattributed hypothesis PriorInSubstanceIsSimpleReading, so no step there passes silently from one sense to the other. Sense fork (docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md): TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks relates the three senses. PrioritySense enumerates simply, inTime and inSubstance; PriorityFrame.PriorIn unfolds them to PriorSimply, PriorInTime (DEF-PRIORITY-IN-TIME, now a frame parameter) and PriorInSubstance. Coverage (STMT-PRIOR-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE) and exclusivity of the route's reading (STMT-PRIOR-SENSE-UNIQUE) are explicit OPEN frontier premises. PRIOR-SENSE-FORK-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR reaches STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY by cases: simple directly, substance through the open bridge STMT-PRIOR-IN-SUBSTANCE-IS-SIMPLE, time refuted under STMT-TEMPORALLY-FIRST-BEING-IN-POTENCY (ACT-NOT-PRIOR-IN-TIME-FROM-TEMPORALLY-FIRST-POTENCY). No strength order among the three senses is provable without a bridge, so none is registered. Semantic linkage audit (2026-11-09): the sense declarations identify the three existing PriorityFrame relation projections, not ActSimplyPriorToPotencyReading or IncorruptiblePriorInSubstanceReading, which are quantified constraints on relations. These projections have distinct field identities but the same function type; this correction does not create type-level protection against swapping arbitrary relation parameters. Their primitive interpretation and remaining obligations are recorded in the linked definitions and docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md. No definitional bridge or new closure is asserted. Priority in being (#1751 slice 2, 2026-11-19): PRIOR_4 (definition f4365b55, PriorityInBeing.PriorInBeing) is the first of the three modes of priority in being, by being-without, In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 15, defined from the primitive CanBeWithout; the second (n. 16) and third (n. 17, act and potency) modes are not formalized as senses here. The prima via route had used the single PriorSimply both for priority in act in a respect (the DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY gloss, carried by a4d3261a, e078f07b and 6ca87431) and for priority in being (47aff057, 97fa3a0b and, through 70e98bb5, 5dacb0db). The original statements keep PRIOR_1 unchanged; their PRIOR_4 siblings are separate statements, and the only passage from PRIOR_4 to PRIOR_1 on the re-derived pure-act route is the open sense-bridge premise 'a first unmoved mover first in being is first in act-priority' (specs/priority-in-being.toml), which, given that every first unmoved mover is first in being, is equivalent to the content of STMT 74eb9113, so the split adds sense hygiene, not warrant for PRIOR_1-firstness. PRIOR_4 is asymmetric by definition, so a PRIOR_1 premise that gives mutual priority under reciprocal cross-respect moving cannot be read as PRIOR_4 (sense-mixing control in that batch). One dependence order (#1926, 2026-11-24, docs/notes/one-dependence-order.md, section 'Sense splits'): the bridge 86efed1a (whatever is PRIOR_1 to another is an actual concrete ground of it) binds PRIOR_1, whose definition is priority in act in a respect, and the hand-and-stick case falsifies it there; its positive warrant (lect. 13 nn. 15-18) belongs to PRIOR_4. The PRIOR_4 sibling restricted to actual concreta (statement 'Between actual CONCRETE_6 individuals at w, what is PRIOR_4 to the other grounds it') carries well-founded actual grounding to PRIOR_4 among actual concreta without an irreflexivity premise. No inclusion between PRIOR_1 and PRIOR_4 is asserted in either direction, and the checked control priorityConsumerLimit gives an interpretation with a PRIOR_1 pair that is not PRIOR_4 and one with a PRIOR_4 pair that is not PRIOR_1; the prima via consumer of d85de8e1 (e229bb2c, through e078f07b) needs PRIOR_1.
